description.narrative: The anticipated development impacts of this Project are: (i) increasing access to the cocoa market by farmers in Côte dIvoire, maintaining local sourcing of traceable and sustainably produced cocoa beans, (ii) promoting local cocoa production and processing and therefore increasing domestic value addition, and creating more jobs; and (iii) maintaining Côte dIvoires market position through local value addition and higher sustainability practices.

The proposed investment is an unfunded risk participation through the Global Structured Trade Finance Program (GTST) of up to EUR 30.25 million to Guan Chong Cocoa Côte dIvoire (GCC CI or the Company) to provide traceable cocoa working capital requirements in Côte dIvoire (the Project). GCC CI is a subsidiary of Guan Chong Berhad (GCB or the Sponsor) is a manufacturer of cocoa-derived food ingredients. The unfunded risk participation of up to EUR 30.25 million will be made available within a EUR 60.5 million revolving trade finance facility to be arranged by Société Générale Côte dIvoire (SGCI or the Bank), on terms to be agreed between the parties.
